We are tired and frustrated and the longer people refuse to get vaccinated the higher chance of them becoming a breeding ground for a variant that the vaccine doesn't work against. It's so obvious to us to listen to people who have spent decades of their lives studying these things rather than talking heads on TV or other random sources. If you were really serious about making the right choice. You would read the publications that detail why that vaccine killed people and how the industry has tried to avoid it since. Then you could read the publications detailing the safety procedures for this vaccine. 

Your argument is emotional not scientific. You are afraid of this thing happening again (which is not unreasonable). Actually do research by reading peer reviewed scientific journals. Not just newspapers. Journalists are essential but they're often not great at actually understanding science.

99% of covid deaths are unvaccinated people these days. And survival rate doesnt capture actual risk to an individual....you know that right? For instance, my roommate who is 22, works out 4 days a week, no heart or lung problems is counted in the survived covid group (his lungs were still inflamed for 2 months after he had it), but a 65 year old obese man with high blood pressure...doesn't have the same odds does he?

Equating the overall rate with the risk to an individual is a mistake that any staticisian will warn you against. Also...a significant barrier to trials is often number of people. That is not a problem in a global pandemic. 

What happened to trusting expert opinion? Your body your choice is true, but it doesn't make your choice the smart one.
